name: data-workflow
description: IDE-agnostic requirement-to-commit workflow for Go/Kratos repos: requirement analysis with nine-item debt gate, impact assessment (blast radius), tech design with artifact tree, implementation guardrails, three-axis parallel change review, contract/interface test gates, quality gate, doc audit before commit, MR, on-call investigation and diagram generation. Business facts load at runtime from a configured knowledge source (config.yaml), never embedded in the skills. 中文：技能只装流程，业务事实运行时从配置的知识源读取。
